name: Juniper Voice Service
description: Client-credentials identity for services/voice. Reads the patient chart broadly to compile the pre-call EHR brief; writes only Encounter, Binary, DocumentReference and Task. Its ProjectMembership must be linked to the 'Juniper Voice Service Policy' AccessPolicy (see medplum/README.md). No secret is committed: Medplum generates one at creation time; retrieve or rotate it in the Medplum app.
